preservedInferenceLimitations.statement: The frozen shift procedure was implemented according to contract, but scientific exchangeability is not independently established.
The sixteen related secondary tests do not establish the dependence conditions for ordinary Benjamini-Hochberg FDR interpretation; stored adjusted values remain unchanged.
Market quote attrition is substantial and can vary by source state and horizon; contract compliance does not establish missing-at-random behavior.
BETWEEN_STATE_EXPLAINED_VARIANCE tests category-conditioned mean-return structure, not every possible difference between conditional return distributions.

preservedReportingAmbiguity.statement: The field privateTestExecutorUsedWithRealData=false is ambiguous because the public executor internally delegates to a shared helper named _for_test; no evidence showed a private bypass.

findingRegister.observedFact: The frozen null rotates state labels over retained, chronologically ordered event positions separately within each side and UTC month; returns and the availability mask remain fixed.
findingRegister.auditReasoning: This exact contract is implemented and reproduced. Its distributional invariance under these rotations is not established by the observational design. Irregular elapsed-time gaps, month-end wrap, overlapping forward windows, calendar effects and conditioning on an observed availability mask can defeat exchangeability. A deterministic hash makes the procedure reproducible, not scientifically exchangeable.
findingRegister.minimumRemediation: Retain this limitation when interpreting these p-values. No change to this experiment or its null is proposed or authorized.

findingRegister.observedFact: The 16 secondary tests reuse events/returns across components and horizons. The ordinary BH adjustment is numerically correct; independence or the relevant positive-regression-dependence condition is not demonstrated.
findingRegister.auditReasoning: Shared observations do not by themselves prove BH invalid, but neither do they establish its FDR-control conditions. Separate deterministic seeds do not remove data dependence. Holm tolerates arbitrary test dependence when marginal p-values are valid; neither adjustment repairs invalid marginal null calibration.
findingRegister.minimumRemediation: Describe secondary BH values as frozen calculated adjustments, without an unconditional proven-FDR claim. Do not substitute a new method or rerun this result.

findingRegister.observedFact: Observed missing-return fractions range from 26.60% to 47.00%; they rise from 1h to 6h to 24h in every side/component cell. USD C05 at 24h drops 3/4 (18 available) and FULL (14 available), leaving 136 retained observations.
findingRegister.auditReasoning: All exclusions match the frozen 60-second quote tolerance and state/sample thresholds. The tested sample is conditional on availability and retained categories, not all 645 events or all source categories. State-skewed attrition is visible; missing-at-random is not established. No missing returns were filled.
findingRegister.minimumRemediation: Preserve the complete attrition and retained-state tables. Do not replace quotes, adjust thresholds or rescue omitted states.

findingRegister.observedFact: The statistic is a nonnegative ratio of between-category mean-return sum of squares to total sum of squares, using literal categories from the accepted source snapshot.
findingRegister.auditReasoning: This tests a contrast in category-conditioned mean forward log returns under the frozen shift reference. It is not an omnibus test of every possible distributional difference, source truth, causality or forecast performance. Source-reproduction agreement does not independently validate the chosen historical interpretations.
findingRegister.minimumRemediation: State the tested mean-return question precisely and retain the discovery-only boundary. Do not infer any market direction, magnitude or general conclusion about astrology.

findingRegister.observedFact: Acceptance says privateTestExecutorUsedWithRealData=false. The frozen public executor calls _execute_low_memory_with_verified_inputs_for_test after validation, passing the real verified runtime, raw quote-stream factory and canonical root; the helper calls _result_document and write_first_result.
findingRegister.auditReasoning: If the field means no direct test-bypass invocation, it is consistent with the reported launch. If read literally as no execution of that helper with real inputs, it is false. The public signature does not expose alternate result roots or caller-selected observations, and the helper call is not evidence of a second invocation or scientific bypass. Independent output reproduction is exact.
findingRegister.minimumRemediation: In a separately authorized additive provenance clarification, distinguish no direct private/test-bypass invocation from internal use of the shared helper. Preserve historical records; do not modify frozen implementation or results in this audit.

findingRegister.observedFact: The result is introduced once in the checked Git lineage and protected by an exclusive first-result write. Invocation count=1, zero scientific retries and zero historical provider calls are recorded execution claims.
findingRegister.auditReasoning: Git and the canonical result establish committed state, not every local process launch or failed pre-write attempt. No durable comprehensive invocation journal is bound here. This audit made zero provider calls and zero production/private executor calls, but cannot retroactively prove all historical process activity.
findingRegister.minimumRemediation: Keep REPOSITORY_VERIFIED_FACT distinct from LOCAL_EXECUTION_PROVENANCE_CLAIM. No repair is required to the numerical artifact.

findingRegister.observedFact: The historical Evaluator B loader expects 4C7D0C... while the committed LF file hashes to 979B194.... An in-memory LF-to-CRLF representation matches the former exactly. The same canonical bytes exist before EMP2-R2; the frozen RUN1 bundle explicitly admits this rendering.
findingRegister.auditReasoning: This is the inherited direct-checkout/full-suite collection incompatibility, not a post-outcome source change. EMP2 consumes the self-hashed projected source snapshot, not Evaluator B at runtime. Snapshot A/B/comparison identities bind to the historical successful AUTH1 record. No empirical-input invalidation was found from this mismatch.
findingRegister.minimumRemediation: Retain as known suite debt. No normalization, rehashing, evaluator rerun or code repair in this audit.
